highlights.title: SoftBank’s $40 Billion Loan for OpenAI Stake Gets 21 New Lenders
highlights.description: SoftBank Group Corp.’s $40 billion bridge loan for its investment in US tech giant OpenAI has attracted a new group of 21 lenders in a broader syndication phase, according to people familiar with the matter.

highlights.title: Chipmaker CXMT’s 466% market debut surge makes it the most valuable China-listed company
highlights.description: The Hefei-based company raised 57.92 billion yuan ($8.6 billion) after pricing its IPO at 8.66 yuan per share.

highlights.title: Instagram, Facebook Ran AI ‘Nudify’ Ads from China, NGO Says
highlights.description: Meta Platforms Inc.’s Facebook and Instagram have served thousands of ads for AI “nudify” apps in breach of the company’s policies, delivered by one of its few advertising partners in China, according to the nonprofit Tech Transparency Project.

highlights.title: Multiverse Raising Funds at $1.7 Billion Value to Cut AI Costs
highlights.description: Multiverse Computing SL is raising $570 million in a funding round that is set to boost its valuation to $1.7 billion, as investors flock to companies aiming to make it cheaper to use artificial intelligence.

highlights.title: FOSS smashed one Microsoft monopoly. After 20 years of failure, it's time to smash another
Foxconn drops VMware, adopts hyperconverged upstart Arcrfra for workloads including AI
highlights.description: PLUS: New CEO for Infosys; China fines Trip.com; India demands GitHub remove Jack Dorsey's distributed social network; And more!

highlights.title: Europe got its own TBPN-style live show, and everyone’s angling for a guest spot
highlights.description: On Monday, the network announced a $1.6 million seed round from top players in the media ecosystem, including Powerhouse Capital, Axel Springer SE (which owns Business Insider and Politico), the popular media publication LadBible, and angel investors from OpenAI and DeepMind. With this fresh capital, the network is announcing its largest expansion yet.

highlights.title: Moonshot AI accessed Nvidia's chips despite Chinese export ban, White House official says
highlights.description: A White House official said Moonshot AI, which released the powerful Kimi K3 model last week, accessed Nvidia's GB300 chips in Thailand.

highlights.title: CXMT Founder Zhu Yiming Pledges $5.6 Billion in Worker Bonuses After China IPO
highlights.description: Zhu Yiming just joined a growing number of billionaires who have amassed great wealth in the race between the US and China for global tech dominance.

Update, 6:15 p.m PT: Apple says all the problems previously listed on its Developer website have been resolved. All of the outages listed on its consumer System Status page have also been fixed. 
Apple says that a number of its services are down this evening. This includes Apple TV, Apple Podcasts, various aspects of the App Store, and more.
